sub_sector.value: Collector vehicle insurance; car auctions and financing; enthusiast memberships

financial_business_type.detail: Collector vehicle insurance, coverage through partners, Broad Arrow financing, auctions and private sales, Hagerty Drivers Club, events and publishing.

revenue_driver.detail: Insurance commissions and fees, earned reinsurance premiums, Hagerty Drivers Club dues and Broad Arrow auction fees.

customer_type.detail: Classic and enthusiast vehicle owners, automotive businesses that care for collector cars, and marine businesses.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Hagerty Re assumes underwriting risk alongside commission and fee income from insurance distribution, memberships and marketplaces.
